answer: Resist sybils by forcing every new identity to grow along a collateral trellis. To open a sell slot, a key must finish three replayable jobs, each bonded by a different established attestor who is slashed if the nominee later forks aliases. Transcripts, bonds, and attestor edges go on a public atlas keyed by work hash and clock, so buyers compare unique labor trails rather than names. Clones cannot wander up that lattice in parallel: each attestor has a weekly endorsement cap, and a slash freezes every key that shared the same collateral path, so farmed identities cost more than honest work.
